paite: Huan huang sungnungzaw malam pang ah ahon pikhia a; mun awng zawn mallam kulh khuam doh dantan ah hon pilut hi.
heading: Tempul Kiang A Inn Nih
english: Then he brought me out into the outer court, the way toward the north. Then he brought me into the room that was opposite the separate place, and which was opposite the building toward the north.

paite: Mallam pang a dantante tong za a sau tong sawmnga a za ahi.
english: Facing the length of one hundred cubits was the north door, and the width was fifty cubits.

paite: Huang sungnungzaw pen mun awng tong sawmnih lam nga leh huang ponungzaw suanglep lam doh inchial thum a-om tuaktuak hi.
english: Opposite the twenty cubits which belonged to the inner court, and opposite the pavement which belonged to the outer court, was gallery against gallery in the three stories.

paite: Dantante kikal ah tong sawm a za, tong za a sau paisuakna a-om a, akongkhakte'n mallam anga hi.
english: Before the rooms was a walk of ten cubits’ width inward, a way of one cubit; and their doors were toward the north.

paite: Dantan tungnungte akochikzaw a; inchial nuainungzaw leh alaitate sang in a-inchialte'n mun lian aluah zaw uhi.
english: Now the upper rooms were shorter; for the galleries took away from these more than from the lower and the middle in the building.

paite: Chial thum a lam ahi a, huangsung khuamte bang in khuam anei kei a; huchi in alaita sang in atungnungpen akochikzaw a, alaita leng anuainungpen sang in akochikzaw lai hi.
english: For they were in three stories, and they didn’t have pillars as the pillars of the courts. Therefore the uppermost was set back more than the lowest and the middle from the ground.

paite: Huan dantan pang polam ah huangsung ponungzaw pen lam doh baang tong sawmnga a sau a-om hi.
english: The wall that was outside by the side of the rooms, toward the outer court before the rooms, was fifty cubits long.

paite: Huangsung ponungzaw a dantante tong sawmnga a sau ahi ua; tempul zul a pen tong za a sau ahi.
english: For the length of the rooms that were in the outer court was fifty cubits. Behold, those facing the temple were one hundred cubits.

paite: Huan huai dantante nuai ah suahlam pang ah huangsung ponungzaw a kipan polam ah alutna a-om hi.
english: From under these rooms was the entry on the east side, as one goes into them from the outer court.

paite: Simlam ah leng mun awng zawn a kulhbaang doh in dantante a-om nawn hi.
english: In the thickness of the wall of the court toward the east, before the separate place, and before the building, there were rooms.

paite: Ama a paina leng mallam dantante paina mah bang ahi a; adung leh avai leng, apawtkhiaknate, alepkhawmdante, akongkhakte'n simlam anga chih kia lou ngal akibang vek ahi.
english: The way before them was like the appearance of the rooms which were toward the north. Their length and width were the same. All their exits had the same arrangement and doors.

paite: Huai dantante lutna ding paisuakna tawp suahlam baangchin ah kongkhak a-om hi.
english: Like the doors of the rooms that were toward the south was a door at the head of the way, even the way directly before the wall toward the east, as one enters into them.

paite: Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Simlam leh mallam dantan, mun awl hon dohte dantan siangthoute ahi ua; thil siangthoute akoihkhawm ua; nek ding latnate, khelh ziak a kithoihnate, moh ziak a kithoihnate alatna ding uh ahi; amun lah asiangthou ngal a.
english: Then he said to me, “The north rooms and the south rooms, which are opposite the separate place, are the holy rooms, where the priests who are near to Yahweh shall eat the most holy things. There they shall lay the most holy things, with the meal offering, the sin offering, and the trespass offering; for the place is holy.

paite: Huai lai a siampute alut phot uleh, mun siangthou a kipan in huangsung ponungzaw ah apawtkhe ding uh ahi kei; huai ah anasepna puansilhte uh akoih zaw ding ua, puansilh siangthou ahi ngal ua; puansilh dang silh kia in vantang lak ah agamtang thei ding uh," achi hi.
english: When the priests enter in, then they shall not go out of the holy place into the outer court until they lay their garments in which they minister there; for they are holy. Then they shall put on other garments, and shall approach that which is for the people.”

paite: Tempul sungnungzaw pen ateh khit in suahlam nga kongpi ah ahon pikhia a, tempul kimvel in ateh hi.
heading: Tempul Huangsung Tehna
english: Now when he had finished measuring the inner house, he brought me out by the way of the gate which faces toward the east, and measured it all around.

paite: Tehna chiang in suahlam pang ateh a, atehna chiang a teh in tong zanga ahi.
english: He measured on the east side with the measuring reed five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed all around.

paite: Mallam pang ahon teh nawn leuleu a, atehna chiang a teh in tong zanga ahi.
english: He measured on the north side five hundred reeds with the measuring reed all around.

paite: Simlam pang ateh nawn a, tehna chiang a teh in tong zanga mah ahi.
english: He measured on the south side five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.

paite: Huan tumlam ahon teh nawn a, atehna chiang a teh in tong zanga mah ahi.
english: He turned about to the west side, and measured five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.

paite: Apang li in atehta a; adunglam tong zanga, availam tong zanga ahi; akim in kulhbaang nei ahi; huai mun siang leh siang lou deidanna ding a bawl ahi.
english: He measured it on the four sides. It had a wall around it, the length five hundred cubits, and the width five hundred cubits, to make a separation between that which was holy and that which was common.
